failure_modes.description: Final output includes markdown formatting and sentence structure around the answer when task specification explicitly requires plain value in minimal format; extraction captures the formatted text instead of the plain value and fails exact-match grading despite correct underlying reasoning
failure_modes.needed_instead: When task instruction specifies minimal-format output (name only, number only), respond with exactly the value specified, without markdown formatting, explanatory context, or additional text

representative_evidence.quote: Instruction: 'Answer with the name only.' | Agent output: '**Sawyer** owns the rabbit.' | Expected: 'Sawyer'

failure_modes.description: When task data selection or filtering criteria are unspecified or ambiguous, the system proceeds with implicit assumptions about which records or values to include without detecting the ambiguity; this produces incorrect intermediate aggregations, sums, or derived values, diverging from the expected answer
failure_modes.needed_instead: Explicitly enumerate and validate assumptions about data scope and filtering before performing aggregations or calculations; verify the interpretation against expected result magnitude; request clarification if the specification is ambiguous about inclusion criteria

representative_evidence.quote: Agent calculated: 30,786.20 ÷ 13 = 2,368.15. Expected: 2379.20. Discrepancy indicates misaligned assumptions about which values to sum or how many records to include in the aggregation.

success_habits.description: Identify and anchor the solution search space using high-leverage constraints that maximally reduce combinatorial branching; treat these anchors as load-bearing foundations for subsequent deduction rather than treating all constraints equally in the search
success_habits.risk_if_broken: Without constraint anchors to prune the search space, the system faces exponential branching in possible configurations; reasoning degrades to trial-and-error enumeration; invalid partial assignments propagate unchecked; the problem becomes computationally intractable

success_habits.description: Enumerate discrete, bounded scenarios consistent with anchor constraints; systematically test each scenario against the full set of constraints before committing to intermediate conclusions; validate that all constraints remain satisfied across the proposed solution
success_habits.risk_if_broken: Without scenario-by-scenario validation against all constraints, the system commits to partial assignments that violate downstream constraints; conflicts accumulate undetected; the final answer appears well-reasoned but is internally inconsistent and unsupported by constraint satisfaction

success_habits.description: Iteratively apply constraints to derive new facts and assignments; cite constraint references explicitly when applying them; propagate newly derived facts forward to further restrict or eliminate candidate assignments; repeat until no new facts can be derived
success_habits.risk_if_broken: Without forward-chaining propagation of derived facts, constraints are applied only in local isolation; new facts from constraint application are not used to eliminate other candidates; the reasoning chain remains incomplete; valid solutions appear invalid due to lack of closure under constraint application

success_habits.description: Adhere precisely to explicit output format instructions in task specification; deliver answers in the exact format required (plain value, numeric format, markdown/plain text as specified, structured fields) without deviating to add explanation, padding, or alternative formulations
success_habits.risk_if_broken: Violating format specification causes exact-match string grading to fail even when the underlying reasoning, calculation, or answer identification is correct; the harness cannot extract and validate the answer if output format does not match the expected extraction pattern; all successful task completions depend on meeting format expectations
